roomGalleries.alt: From the foot of the bed: a dark daybed, a round wooden table and glass doors with two palms and white surf beyond.
The whole room: a king bed with a teak headboard on the right, a cowhide on the floor, a ceiling fan and the glass doors to the sea on the left.
A king bed against a pale wall, with chevron-panelled teak wardrobe doors and a short corridor behind it.
A white stone basin under a lit mirror, a teak splashback and a glass-walled shower to the left.
From behind the beds: glass doors with a bent palm and white surf, curtains drawn to each side, a round table to the right.
Two beds side by side on small dark rugs, chevron-panelled teak wardrobe doors on the wall behind.
Two beds on the left, sliding glass doors filling the right with palms, sea and a table with a red-shaded lamp.
A round wooden table with a water bottle and a small plant, two wooden chairs with woven seats and a red-shaded floor lamp in front of sheer curtains.
A teak desk built into the back of the bed, seen from the side, with a glimpse of the pool and lawn through the glass doors.
The corner of a white bed, a round table with flowers and a red lamp, and glass doors with the pool, a parasol and the sea.
A white bed along the left, a jute rug and sliding glass doors on the right with palms and a lounge chair outside.
A deep white stand-alone tub with a teak tray against a dark wall, and through a doorway a desk and a palm in the window.
A bathroom with dual white basins on the left, a towel ladder and the stand-alone soaking tub under a lit niche.
From the bed: a corner of glass with palms and surf on the left, a television unit, a grey sofa and a tall mirror.
A long teak desk and a grey sofa in the foreground, and the bed beyond a television unit.
A walk-in wardrobe lined in teak, with a white robe on a hanger and open shelves on either side.
From the wardrobe, a long teak-backed double basin running towards a white tub at the far end.
A marble bathroom with a stand-alone tub beyond a glass door and a double basin in the foreground.
